thread:
alicia: Hey, trying the Hello World sample from the console. After I paste my API key and click 'Make first call' the status sits on 'Initializing...' forever. No errors in the UI. Anyone seen this? stuck on welcome screen :thinking_face:

devex-bot: deploy-check: hello-world-sample container running, health OK. No obvious deploy failures.

sam: Can you paste the browser console logs and a curl from the local sample? Also which key type are you using — user token or service key?

alicia: Pasted curl output: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_xyz" -d '{"input":"hi"}'` -> HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
Response body: `{"error":"billing_required","message":"Activate billing for workspace ws_abc to make requests"}`
Browser console: `Failed to fetch` then spinner never stops.

jordan: 402 usually means billing not enabled on the workspace. The console normally shows a banner but I've seen invited orgs where the banner doesn't appear. Did you accept an invite or create a new org?

alicia: I accepted an invite from a teammate. In the workspace dropdown it says 'Trial - pending billing' but no obvious CTA to add payment info.

sam: Two things here: 1) sample app's client is treating 4xx as transient and retrying indefinitely — that keeps the UI stuck on initializing. 2) console is hiding the billing CTA for certain invited workspaces. Quick workaround: either add a card under Org → Billing or use a service key. To check programmatically: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/me` -> look for `"billing_enabled": false`.

alicia: Ran that, got back `{"id":"ws_abc","billing_enabled":false}`. Switching to the service key now to test.

devex-bot: note created: DEVEX-412 "quickstart: handle 402 explicitly & surface billing CTA"

sam: I'll open a tiny fix for the sample app: detect 402 and show a billing modal instead of retrying. Example change: `if (resp.status === 402) { showBillingModal(); return; }` Also will update SDK error mapping so `billing_required` is exposed to apps.

jordan: Filing UX bug for console banner on invited workspaces (UX-87). We should show the billing banner whenever `billing_enabled` is false and the caller has workspace admin rights.

alicia: Confirmed — switching to the service key worked. First call returned 200 and the sample printed the response. :tada:

sam: Great! Follow-ups: PR #5234 (sample fix), PR #5235 (SDK error class), UX-87 (console banner). Assigning sam + jordan. Thanks everyone :heart:
